title: IPC capability
description: A named authority a client may be granted at handshake. The set is CLOSED: an unknown capability name is never silently elevated, and `admin.*` is obtainable only on the administrative socket — never by claiming an administrative `client.kind` on the data socket (ADR-0037). `admin.status` (1.1.0, A 2026-09-28) is the read-only administrative authority: status may be read without holding a mutation capability.
